description:
On the border between the United States and Canada lies a system of waterways so vast it can be seen from space. 
These are the Great Lakes — the largest group of freshwater lakes on Earth, stretching across more than 94,000 square miles. 
They form an entire inland world, where water shapes the climate, carves the landscape, and defines the lives of millions.
